body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L,d)\), \(\tau(x)=\mathbb E_P[Y(1)-Y(0)\mid X=x]\) for \(\lambda\)-almost every \(x\).
body.justification: This identifies the statistical regression contrast as the causal CATE without adding a learner or an oracle nuisance.
body.gap: The identification step is standard under HernanRobins2020; it fixes the causal interpretation and is not claimed as novel.
body.consumer: Applied users of the resulting test can state precisely which causal heterogeneity functional is being tested.
